name: MonarchMessageRow
title: MessageRow
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row with androidx.compose.foundation.gestures.detectTapGestures (long press) and androidx.compose.material3.DropdownMenu; MonarchAvatar, MonarchBadge, MonarchReactionBar, MonarchButton; android.icu.text.RelativeDateTimeFormatter and DateFormat for the time
summary: One message in a conversation: avatar, author, time and body, with pending, failed, edited and deleted states, reactions, a thread reply count and actions on long press.
whenToUse: For each message of a chat, a comment thread or a support conversation, with grouped set on follow-ups from the same author.
whenNotToUse: For a list of conversations, use MonarchInboxRow. For an AI assistant's turn, use the intelligence components such as MonarchAiConversation. For an activity feed of events, use MonarchActivityTimeline.
api: @Composable fun MonarchMessageRow(author: MonarchMessageRowAuthor, time: Long, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, now: Long? = null, variant: MonarchMessageRowVariant = MonarchMessageRowVariant.Standard, status: MonarchMessageRowStatus = MonarchMessageRowStatus.Sent, timeStyle: MonarchMessageRowTimeStyle = MonarchMessageRowTimeStyle.Relative, errorMessage: String? = null, tags: List<String> = emptyList(), reactions: List<MonarchReactionBarItem> = emptyList(), replyCount: Int = 0, grouped: Boolean = false, edited: Boolean = false, deleted: Boolean = false, highlighted: Boolean = false, actions: List<MonarchMessageRowAction> = emptyList(), quickReactions: List<String> = emptyList(), reactionPicker: (@Composable (onPick: (String) -> Unit, onDismiss: () -> Unit) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchMessageRowLabels = MonarchMessageRowLabels(), onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, onDiscard: (() -> Unit)? = null, onShowEdits: (() -> Unit)? = null, onReactionToggle: ((emoji: String, reacted: Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, onOpenThread: (() -> Unit)? = null, content: @Composable () -> Unit)
class MonarchMessageRowAuthor(name: String, image: Painter? = null, seed: String? = null)
class MonarchMessageRowAction(label: String, onClick: () -> Unit, destructive: Boolean = false, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)
enum class MonarchMessageRowVariant { Standard, Internal, System }
enum class MonarchMessageRowStatus { Sent, Pending, Failed }

class MonarchMessageRowLabels(sending: String? = null, failed: String? = null, retry: String? = null, discard: String? = null, edited: String? = null, editHistory: String? = null, deleted: String? = null, replies: ((Int) -> String)? = null, actions: String? = null, reactions: MonarchReactionBarLabels = MonarchReactionBarLabels())

options.name: author
options.description: The name, and the avatar picture as a Painter the app loaded; initials otherwise.

options.name: time
options.description: When the message was sent, in epoch milliseconds (UTC).

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the row.

options.name: now
options.description: Fixes now for the relative time. Without it the time follows the clock and refreshes every minute.

options.name: variant
options.description: Standard, Internal (warning tint and a bar along the start edge) or System (a centered caption line without avatar or author).

options.name: status
options.description: Sent, Pending (muted body and Sending…) or Failed (the error, with Retry and Discard).

options.name: timeStyle
options.description: Relative (5 minutes ago, then a short date after a week) or Clock (2:05 PM).

options.name: errorMessage
options.description: Why sending failed. Not sent by default.

options.name: tags
options.description: Neutral MonarchBadges after the author name, such as Internal or Guest.

options.name: reactions
options.description: Emoji reactions, shown with MonarchReactionBar under the body.

options.name: replyCount
options.description: Thread replies, shown as 1 reply or 4 replies when above zero.

options.name: grouped
options.description: A follow-up from the same author: the avatar and header are hidden and the body lines up with the first message.

options.name: edited
options.description: Shows the (edited) marker.

options.name: deleted
options.description: Replaces the body with This message was deleted. in muted italics and hides reactions, replies and actions.

options.name: highlighted
options.description: Tints the row with the subtle accent color, for example after opening a link to the message. The change animates unless animations are off.

options.name: actions
options.description: Reply, edit, copy, delete: a menu opened by long press and TalkBack actions. Offered only for a sent, not deleted, non-system message.

options.name: quickReactions
options.description: Emoji offered by the reaction bar's add button when no reactionPicker is given.

options.name: reactionPicker
options.description: The app's emoji picker for the reaction bar's add button.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string, including the reaction bar's.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Adds Retry to a failed message.

options.name: onDiscard
options.description: Adds Discard to a failed message.

options.name: onShowEdits
options.description: Makes the edited marker a button named Edited. Show edit history.

options.name: onReactionToggle
options.description: Receives the emoji and the new state. Without it the reactions are read-only.

options.name: onOpenThread
options.description: Makes the reply count a button.

options.name: content
options.description: The message body: text, attachments, link cards. The content color is muted while pending.

states.name: first of a group
states.description: Avatar, author in the strong body style, tags and the muted time above the body.

states.name: grouped
states.description: No avatar or header; the body lines up under the first message and the vertical padding is smaller.

states.name: pending
states.description: The body's content color is muted and Sending… is shown under it. No actions.

states.name: failed
states.description: The error, or Not sent, in the strong danger color under the body, with Retry and Discard when given. No actions.

states.name: edited
states.description: An (edited) caption after the body, a link-coloured button when onShowEdits is given.

states.name: deleted
states.description: The body is replaced by This message was deleted. in muted italics; reactions, replies and actions are hidden.

states.name: internal
states.description: The subtle warning fill with a bar in the warning border color along the start edge.

states.name: highlighted
states.description: The subtle accent fill, animated in and out unless animations are off.

states.name: system
states.description: A centered muted caption with the time below it, without avatar, author, reactions or actions.

appearance: The row has no fill of its own; internal notes use the subtle warning fill with a warning border bar, and a highlighted row the subtle accent fill. The author is default text in the strong body style, the time and markers muted captions, a failure the strong danger color and the edited link the link color. The same roles adapt to dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: On the web the per-message actions are a hover toolbar that also appears on focus, and on iOS a contextMenu; on Android they are a Material 3 DropdownMenu opened by long press with a long-press haptic, the touch convention, and each action is also a TalkBack action. Actions are MonarchMessageRowAction values rather than a slot, because TalkBack actions need a label and a callback. The web shows a grouped message's clock time in the gutter on hover; there is no hover on touch, so the gutter stays empty and TalkBack reads the author and full date on every message. The web and iOS draw a danger icon on failures; Monarch bundles no icons, so the error text carries the meaning. The reaction bar's add button opens the app's picker or a menu of quickReactions, because Monarch has no emoji picker on Android yet (androidx.emoji2:emoji2-emojipicker is not a dependency). The web's avatar slot and footer slot are not offered: the avatar is MonarchAvatar from author, and a footer goes in content. Times are epoch milliseconds; the web also takes Date and ISO strings, and its locale and timeZone parameters are the device's here. Booleans have no is prefix (grouped, edited, deleted, highlighted), unlike iOS. Experimental: a domain pattern until a Rook app adopts it.
accessibility: The author, tags, full date and time, body, edited marker and Sending… are merged into one TalkBack element.
A grouped message still begins with the author and the full date and time for TalkBack, through a node that is not drawn.
The visible relative or clock time is replaced by the full date and time for TalkBack.
Actions are TalkBack custom actions, and the long press is announced as Message actions.
A failure is written in a polite live region that is always present, so it is announced when the status changes; Retry and Discard are separate buttons.
Reactions use MonarchReactionBar: chips named by emoji name and count. The thread button is a separate button.
The avatar is decorative; the author is read from the header.
Retry, Discard, the edit-history marker, the thread button and reaction chips have touch targets of at least 48dp; text wraps at font scale 2.0.
edgeCases: A time in the future reads as now; from seven days the relative time shows a short date, with the year when it is not this year.
A deleted message with edited set shows no edited marker.
Actions are not offered while pending or failed, so a long press does nothing then.
A reply count of zero shows nothing.
Without now, a LaunchedEffect refreshes the relative time every minute while the row is on screen.
